passages.text: Plants of the World Online account: Quercus × gallaecica Llamas, Lence & Acedo.
The native range of this hybrid is Iberian Peninsula. It is a tree and grows primarily in the temperate biome. The hybrid formula is Q. lusitanica × Q. orocantabrica.
